items.source: Specification for providing the body and the URI of a request.
items.translation: 提供请求主体和 URI 的规范。
`WebTestClient.RequestBodySpec` 接口在 `org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server` 包中的用法

items.source: Support for testing Spring WebFlux server endpoints via WebTestClient.
items.translation: 支持通过 WebTestClient 测试 Spring WebFlux 服务器端点。

items.source: Set the media type of the body, as specified by the Content-Type header.
items.translation: 设置正文的媒体类型，如Content-Type标头中指定。

items.source: Set the length of the body in bytes, as specified by the Content-Length header.
items.translation: 设置以 Content-Length 标头指定的字节数作为正文长度。

items.source: Specification for providing the body of a request.
